scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Rehabilitation of Sick Enterprises
other_conditions: Enterprise must be a Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise (MSME).
Enterprise must satisfy RBI guidelines for sickness.
Application must be submitted with audited balance sheets for verification.
benefits_summary: Financial reimbursement of 50% of the cost of preparing the Draft Rehabilitation Scheme, up to ₹1,00,000.
